lines.zh: 我一动不动，我是展示品。
lines.en: I don't move. I'm a display piece.

lines.zh: 脚下钉着，走不了。
lines.en: My feet are fixed. I can't walk.

lines.zh: 白天站在这里，晚上才不一样。
lines.en: I stand here by day. Night is different.

lines.zh: 我的姿势是摆好的，别碰。
lines.en: My pose was set on purpose. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 有人从我面前走过，看了两眼。
lines.en: Someone walked past and glanced at me twice.

lines.zh: 我身上落了灰，没人擦。
lines.en: Dust settles on me. No one wipes it off.

lines.zh: 展台不大，我占了大半。
lines.en: The platform is small; I take most of it.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，脸对着门口。
lines.en: I stand angled, my face toward the door.

lines.zh: 灯照过来，我的眼睛亮一下。
lines.en: The lamp comes on and my eyes glint.

lines.zh: 这个位置，是我被放在这的。
lines.en: This spot is where I was put.

lines.zh: 我不动，但我的影子在动。
lines.en: I stay still, but my shadow moves.

lines.zh: 腿上的布被人摸得起球了。
lines.en: The cloth on my legs has pilled from handling.

lines.zh: 我脚下有一圈磨损的痕。
lines.en: There's a worn ring around my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬不起手，关节锈住了。
lines.en: I can't lift my arm. The joint is rusted.

lines.zh: 有人在我旁边拍照，光闪了一下。
lines.en: Someone photographed me. A flash went off.

lines.zh: 我等着，等到灯都关了。
lines.en: I wait until every light goes out.

lines.zh: 我站着，像站了很多年。
lines.en: I stand as if I've stood for years.

lines.zh: 脸上的漆掉了一块。
lines.en: A chip of paint has come off my face.

lines.zh: 里面是空的，能听见回音。
lines.en: It's hollow inside. I can hear the echo.

lines.zh: 有虫子在我衣服里爬。
lines.en: A bug is crawling inside my clothes.

lines.zh: 我嘴上的漆已经掉了。
lines.en: The paint on my mouth has peeled.

lines.zh: 灯关了，我也还是这样。
lines.en: The lights are off, and I'm still like this.

lines.zh: 门口的光很亮，我照不到。
lines.en: The light at the door is bright. It doesn't reach me.

lines.zh: 有人说是修不好了。
lines.en: Someone said I can't be repaired.

lines.zh: 我不合眼，因为没有眼皮。
lines.en: I don't blink. I have no eyelids.

lines.zh: 靴子上的缝线开了。
lines.en: A seam on my boot has split.

lines.zh: 我数着白天过得多慢。
lines.en: I count how slowly the daytime passes.

lines.zh: 这些孩子从我面前跑过去。
lines.en: Children run past in front of me.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的音乐盒。
lines.en: I hear a music box far off.

lines.zh: 我的手指一直伸着，放不下来。
lines.en: My fingers stay extended. They won't lower.

lines.zh: 没人跟我说话，我也不说。
lines.en: No one talks to me. I don't talk either.

lines.zh: 等天黑了，我就不是我了。
lines.en: When night falls, I won't be myself.

lines.zh: 你的手电照着我半边脸。
lines.en: Your torch lights half my face.

lines.zh: 我不会动，你可以靠近。
lines.en: I won't move. You can come closer.

lines.zh: 别弄乱我的姿势。
lines.en: Don't disturb my pose.

lines.zh: 你喜欢这副旧样子吗？
lines.en: Do you like this worn-out look?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找我的眼睛。
lines.en: Your eyes are looking for mine.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，只是摆设。
lines.en: I stand here only as decoration.

lines.zh: 你摸一下也行，反正我拦不住。
lines.en: You may touch me. I can't stop you.

lines.zh: 天还没黑，不急。
lines.en: It isn't dark yet. No hurry.

lines.zh: 你身后的门，看得见吗？
lines.en: Can you see the door behind you?

lines.zh: 等你走了，我就醒了。
lines.en: Once you leave, I wake up.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，吓到你了吧。
lines.en: This face frightens you, doesn't it.

lines.zh: 你退后了，我就知道。
lines.en: You stepped back. I knew you would.

lines.zh: 我歪了，却正不回来。
lines.en: I've been knocked askew and can't right myself.

lines.zh: 这一下，漆又掉了一块。
lines.en: Another chip of paint came off.

lines.zh: 我不能躲，只能受着。
lines.en: I can't dodge. I can only take it.

lines.zh: 里面的架子响了一声。
lines.en: The frame inside creaked.

lines.zh: 有东西从我衣服里面掉出来。
lines.en: Something fell out of my clothes.

lines.zh: 别打了，我站不住了。
lines.en: Stop. I can't stay upright.

lines.zh: 我听见自己身上的零件在响。
lines.en: I hear my own parts rattling.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我打得转了个向。
lines.en: That spun me around.

lines.zh: 底座裂了，我歪到一边。
lines.en: My base cracked and I'm leaning.

lines.zh: 我还在，只是更旧了。
lines.en: I'm still here. Only older.

lines.zh: 我吃不了，可你放着吧。
lines.en: I can't eat it, but leave it there.

lines.zh: 你放在我手上试试。
lines.en: Try setting it in my hand.

lines.zh: 以前有人往我嘴里塞东西。
lines.en: People used to stuff things in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我张不开嘴，你看见了吗。
lines.en: I can't open my mouth. See?

lines.zh: 这味道，我闻不到。
lines.en: I can't smell it.

lines.zh: 你把它放在展台上，会有人收走。
lines.en: Leave it on the platform and someone will collect it.

lines.zh: 我连眼睛都不会转。
lines.en: I can't even turn my eyes.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我却接不住。
lines.en: You're holding it out, and I can't take it.

lines.zh: 这一带的老鼠比我吃得香。
lines.en: The rats here eat better than I do.

lines.zh: 放着吧，我等晚上。
lines.en: Leave it. I'll wait for night.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，东西撒了。
lines.en: Steady your hand. It's spilling.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴，只是个画上去的洞。
lines.en: My mouth is only a painted hole.

lines.zh: 你喂我的样子，很认真。
lines.en: You feed me so earnestly.

lines.zh: 我要是能动，会谢谢你。
lines.en: If I could move, I'd thank you.

lines.zh: 这么多，你一个人吃不完。
lines.en: All that, you can't finish alone.

lines.zh: 等入夜，我就不用你喂了。
lines.en: After dark I won't need feeding.

lines.zh: 我的外壳裂了，露出弹簧。
lines.en: My shell cracked and the springs show.

lines.zh: 我的底座是固定的，你也撞不动。
lines.en: My base is fixed. You can't move me.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，灰都起来了。
lines.en: You hit me and the dust rose.

lines.zh: 别推，我的姿势会散。
lines.en: Don't push. My pose will come apart.

lines.zh: 这么硬的东西，撞了会疼。
lines.en: Something this hard hurts to hit.

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，衣角蹭到我。
lines.en: You squeezed past and your sleeve brushed me.

lines.zh: 我歪了一点，自己正不回来。
lines.en: I've tilted slightly. I can't right myself.

lines.zh: 地板被我压出一道痕。
lines.en: My weight has left a groove in the floor.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚了，很硬吧。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. Hard, isn't it.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的布会掉渣。
lines.en: Don't come close. My cloth sheds.

lines.zh: 我动不了，只能看着你。
lines.en: I can't move. I can only look at you.

lines.zh: 你站在那，就跟我说说话吧。
lines.en: Stand there and talk to me.

lines.zh: 这身旧衣服，没什么好夸的。
lines.en: There's nothing to praise about these old clothes.

lines.zh: 你愿意靠过来，我很意外。
lines.en: You'd come this close. I'm surprised.

lines.zh: 我身上很凉，你手会冷。
lines.en: I'm cold. Your hand will get cold.

lines.zh: 有人陪着站着，天也过得快些。
lines.en: Standing with someone makes the day pass quicker.

lines.zh: 等灯关了，我就不记得了。
lines.en: Once the lights go out, I won't remember.

lines.zh: 你别留太晚。
lines.en: Don't stay too late.

lines.zh: 我这身旧皮，白天只能站着。
lines.en: This worn suit; by day I can only stand.

lines.zh: 明天你还来吗？
lines.en: Will you come tomorrow?

lines.zh: 腰弯不下去，我直接抓。
lines.en: I cannot bend; I grab it outright.

lines.zh: 你放在我手上，我拿着。
lines.en: Put it in my hand and I'll hold it.

lines.zh: 我手指合不拢，会掉。
lines.en: My fingers won't close. It'll fall.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我都没法捡。
lines.en: Anything dropped, I can't pick up.

lines.zh: 你替我捡一下吧。
lines.en: Pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 这东西放在展台上，不像样。
lines.en: This doesn't belong on a display stand.

lines.zh: 我抱着它站了一整天。
lines.en: I held it all day, standing.

lines.zh: 有人把东西塞在我怀里。
lines.en: Someone tucked it into my arms.

lines.zh: 这么重的东西，压得我手更低了。
lines.en: Something this heavy has lowered my hand.

lines.zh: 你收好吧，别放在这。
lines.en: Put it away. Don't leave it here.

lines.zh: 我不会追人，我追不了。
lines.en: I don't chase. I can't.

lines.zh: 你看我，我就看着你。
lines.en: You look at me; I look at you.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我就不一样了。
lines.en: It's getting dark. I'll be different.

lines.zh: 灯灭的那一下，你要注意。
lines.en: Watch the moment the lights go out.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，方向是固定的。
lines.en: My face only points one way.

lines.zh: 有人在我身后走过去了。
lines.en: Someone walked behind me.

lines.zh: 这展厅的出口只有一个。
lines.en: This hall has one exit.

lines.zh: 我在等你走开，就一会儿。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to leave. Just a moment.

lines.zh: 你别以为我什么都做不了。
lines.en: Don't think I can do nothing.

lines.zh: 时间到了，灯要灭了。
lines.en: Time's up. The lights are going out.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着那扇门。
lines.en: I never look away from that door.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我都看不见。
lines.en: Wherever you go, I can't see it.

lines.zh: 我只听，听脚步。
lines.en: I only listen. For footsteps.

lines.zh: 你快跑的时候，地板会响。
lines.en: The floor rings when you run.

lines.zh: 我的位置没变，你的变了。
lines.en: My place hasn't changed. Yours has.

lines.zh: 这里安静得能听见你的呼吸。
lines.en: It's quiet enough to hear you breathe.

lines.zh: 灯在闪，快了。
lines.en: The lights are flickering. Almost.

lines.zh: 你躲到哪，我大概知道。
lines.en: I roughly know where you're hiding.

lines.zh: 别碰我，碰了就会响。
lines.en: Don't touch me. I make noise.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，就到晚上了。
lines.en: Wait a bit more. Then it's night.

lines.zh: 我抬不起手来打人。
lines.en: I can't raise my arm to strike.

lines.zh: 我这一下，连自己都动不了。
lines.en: I can't even move well enough to hit.

lines.zh: 要动手，得等天黑。
lines.en: To fight, you'll have to wait for dark.

lines.zh: 你打我，我不会还手。
lines.en: Hit me and I won't hit back.

lines.zh: 我只想站着，别逼我。
lines.en: I only want to stand here. Don't push me.

lines.zh: 这层铁壳，也挡得住几下。
lines.en: This iron shell can take a few blows.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，自己会疼。
lines.en: Run into me and you'll be the one hurting.

lines.zh: 我不会喊，也不会追。
lines.en: I won't shout and I won't chase.

lines.zh: 入夜之后，就不是这样了。
lines.en: After nightfall, it won't be like this.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮过你的肩膀。
lines.en: My claws rake across your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我在这里摆着，一直摆着。
lines.en: I'm on display here. I've always been.

lines.zh: 展台上落了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust on the platform.

lines.zh: 有人把我搬到了这个位置。
lines.en: Someone moved me to this spot.

lines.zh: 我面朝着门，背靠着墙。
lines.en: I face the door, my back to the wall.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里，我是最早的那批。
lines.en: In this building, I'm one of the oldest.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛被灯照得发亮。
lines.en: The lamp makes my eyes shine.

lines.zh: 我脚下的痕，比这店还老。
lines.en: The marks under my feet are older than the shop.

lines.zh: 有客人在看，我不能动。
lines.en: Customers are looking. I mustn't move.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊上搭着一块布。
lines.en: A cloth is draped over my arm.

lines.zh: 等最后的灯灭了，我就起来。
lines.en: When the last light dies, I get up.

lines.zh: 布烧起来，味道很难闻。
lines.en: The cloth caught fire. A foul smell.

lines.zh: 我从展台上摔下去，碎了几个角。
lines.en: I fell off the platform and broke a few corners.

lines.zh: 水渗进来，里面全是锈味。
lines.en: Water seeped in. It smells of rust.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻在地上。
lines.en: The blast knocked me flat.

lines.zh: 有东西扎在我的壳上，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something's stuck in my shell.

lines.zh: 这光让我身上一轻，又更沉。
lines.en: That light made me light, then heavier.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我在慢慢垮。
lines.en: I don't hunger, but I'm slowly collapsing.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，我一动，真的动了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I twitched. Actually moved.

lines.zh: 这里没有展台。
lines.en: There's no display stand here.
